movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Poison Tail
movelist.effect: Poison Tail is a Critical Hit on 18+, and Poisons the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Poison Sting
movelist.effect: Poison Sting Poisons the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.
